mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversations (user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO chat_messages (conversation_id, message, is_user_message, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{message}, #{isUserMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT chat_conversation_id as chatConversationId, user_id as userId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM chat_conversations WHERE chat_conversation_id = #{id}

SELECT chat_message_id as chatMessageId, conversation_id as conversationId, message, is_user_message as isUserMessage, created_at as createdAt FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT chat_conversation_id as chatConversationId, user_id as userId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM chat_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
